Name: avgCombUpg
Desc:
Average Team-Up attack weapon upgrade values
among the partner units participating in the attack
like in OG CB/FMW

For example, if Reimu has 6 weapon upgrades,
then a 2-unit attack like
Trichromatic Lotus Butterfly would only be boosted
by an equivalent 6/2=3 weapon upgrades
when the averaging logic is applied.
